newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Nenaco unaudited 1996 net 77.113 mln pesos.
newsitem.headline: Nenaco unaudited 1996 net 77.113 mln pesos.

text.p: Negros Navigation Co Inc (Nenaco) said on Tuesday its 1996 unaudited net reached 77.113 million pesos from revenues of 1.461 billion pesos.
The shipping company told the Philippine Stock Exchange it made a net income of 76.892 million pesos in 1995 from revenues of 1.09 billion pesos.
In the past year, it took delivery of more ships, spun off its ferry division, and took a 25 percent equity in TA Bank of the Philippines Inc, Nenaco said in a statement.
The shipping firm said it took delivery of its 16th vessel in October 1996. The vessel has a capacity of 1,200 passengers.

Two other vessels were also delivered to the company in December 1996. One of the vessels is of catamaran type while the other is a roll-on roll-off vessel with a passenger capacity of 1,500. -- Manila newsroom (632) 841-89-36, fax 817-62-67
